messages.content: Open https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/LinkedIn, find the History section, and give me 4 dated facts.

4 dated facts from History section: 1. Founded December 2002 by Reid Hoffman et al. 2. Late 2003: Sequoia Capital Series A investment. 3. August 2004: Reached 1 million users. 4. March 2006: First month of profitability. (Source: search_page History section text)
